archive.identity: The exact SHA-256 is required. A GitHub-generated source tarball or a repacked archive is not interchangeable.

python.executable_policy: No compiled-local executable SHA-256 admission gate. Record the actual resolved interpreter executable SHA-256 in output manifest.json; this is identity evidence, not authenticity verification.

reuse.backend_dir: Caller-supplied absolute --backend-dir (for example, the resolved repo/backend/nut directory)
reuse.derived_function: build_pair: replace only diagnostic host with new host; diagnostics=1 in both builds; pacing=0/1
reuse.all_other_local_inputs: Exact pins in canonical manifest, verified before and after build/execution; canonical manifest is not modified

toolchain.selection: Canonical discover_toolchain; discovered compiler/xcodebuild/SDKSettings hashes recorded and rechecked

fixture_scope: One synthetic scenario; dynamic page 1 validated field by field; page 2 remains unrelated. Summary timing counters are not a lossless trace.

output_identity.root: Caller-selected new private directory strictly under system TMPDIR or /private/tmp; no input overlap
receipts: one bounded command JSON and capture directory per tool invocation
output_identity.command_record: Every actual tool/fake argv, executable hash and supervisor outcome is recorded. No arbitrary command argument is accepted.

commands.default: Python 3.15.2 -I -S -B replay_continuous_pacing.py --backend-dir BACKEND --nut-archive ARCHIVE --new-files-dir NEW_FILES --output-dir NEW_TMP_OUTPUT --compile-only
commands.explicit_fake: Same fixed launch with --run-fake replacing --compile-only; executes only the two admitted fake binaries
commands.build: Exact derived build_pair commands are in the reviewed adapter; command receipts expand all paths and the discovered pinned toolchain

qualification.source_fidelity: Full source-tree before/after hashes; only drivers/apcmicrolink.c may change
qualification.hardware_authorization: No hardware launch or authorization is provided by this manifest or replay API.

revision_note: REV2 changes only the fake cycle to alternate measurement page1 and unrelated final page2, as the admitted same-payload fixture; scheduler and assertions unchanged. REV1 captures retained.
